layout_sources: https://github.com/grdnkln/wealthsimple-csv-to-qfx/blob/main/ws_csv_to_qfx.py (July 2026: monthly statement CSV from Documents, columns date, transaction, description, amount, balance, currency; %Y-%m-%d; plain decimals)
https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/tree/main/ca/wealthsimple (June 2025: header row, Y-m-d, date, transaction, description, amount, balance)
notes: Lowercase header date,transaction,description,amount,balance,currency (a 2025 config shows the same without currency). ISO dates; transaction is Wealthsimple's type code; amount signed, money out negative, plain decimals with no sign or thousands separator; balance after the line; currency CAD on every row. The type codes shown (AFT_IN, SPEND, E_TRFOUT, E_TRFIN, INT), oldest-first order, no BOM, LF and the file name are assumed.
